map.因为统计口径不同：中文通常按字符计（每个汉字 1 字），英文按词计（空格分隔）；: Because the counting basis differs: Chinese is usually counted by character (each Han character = 1), English by word (space-separated); whether punctuation, spaces, and newlines are counted also varies. When exchanging drafts across platforms, agree on a basis first, or just use the platform's own count. For reading time, Chinese is typically estimated at 300–500 chars per minute.
